seo.title: Don't Pick the Wrong Door! 🚪🌶️ Choose a Door Game for Kids | Funny Kids Game | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Don't pick the wrong door! 🚪 Which door will YOU choose? Play the funny choose-a-door game with Kiddo and see what's hiding inside!

A silly guessing game for kids with a sour lemon 🍋, a spicy chili 🌶️ and a sweet birthday cake 🎂. Kids learn food words and tastes (sour, spicy, sweet) while they laugh along.

Pick door 1, 2 or 3 before the countdown ends, then watch Kiddo open them all! Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for a new Pick a Door game every week!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0) · Music and sound effects: original
